Copy the second-stage U-Boot script into the boot tree.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value |
| ------------ | ----- |
| Priority     | `0`   |
| Dependencies | None  |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Copies Bakery's bundled Raspberry Pi second-stage U-Boot script into the layer's
boot tree. The surrounding image assembly must supply the compatible first-stage
boot configuration.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rpi-uboot-setup"]
```
